pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu sna'i 'dus te reg pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu lce'i 'dus te reg pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu lus kyi 'dus te reg pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu yid kyi 'dus te reg pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu sa'i khams gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /21—796

sha ra dwa ti'i bu chu'i khams gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu mye'i khams gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rlung gi khams gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu nam mkha'i khams gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam par shes pa'i khams gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag kyadaka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu ma rig pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'du byed gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam par shes pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu mying dang gzugs gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu skye mched drug gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu reg pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu tshor ba gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu srid pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu len pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu srid pa gting 21—797

dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu skye ba gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rga shi gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu bsam gtan gyi pha rold tu phyin pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu nang stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu phyi stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu phyi nang stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu stong pa nyid stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu chen po stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/21—798

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu don dam pa stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'dus byas stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rang bzhin stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu chos thams cad stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 21—799

dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu yang dag par spong ba gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu dbang po gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu stobs gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub kyi yan lag gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'phags pa'i bden pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu bsam gtan gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu tshad myed pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi chopha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam par thar pa brgyad gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu mthar kyis 21—800

gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu mngon par shes pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu ting nge 'dzin gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzungs kyi sgo gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu myi 'jigs pa bzhi gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ / 27sha ra dwa ti'i bu snying rje chen po gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa 37brgyad gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu thams cad shes pa nyid gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gting 21—801

dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni tshad ma mchis so༅/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzugs tshad myed pa'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'du shes tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do//sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'du byed tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu myig tshad myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rna ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu sna tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu lce tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu lus tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu yid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzugs tshad myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu sgra tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu dri tshad myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu ro tshad myed pa'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu reg tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa 21—802

ti'i bu chos tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu myig gi rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rna ba'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu sna'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do//sha ra dwa ti'i bu lce'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu lus kyi rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu yid kyi rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad skyed do//sha ra dwa ti'i bu myig gi ①'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu sna'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed ②pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu lce'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu lus kyi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu yid kyi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i 21—803

rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do//sha ra dwa ti'i bu lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu sa'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu chu'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu mye'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rlung gi khams tshad myed pa'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu nam mkha'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam par shes pa'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu ma rig pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'du byed tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu mying dang gzugs tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu skye mched drug tshad myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rig pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu tshor 21—804

ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu sred pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do//sha ra dwa ti'i bu len pa tshade myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu srid pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu skye ba tshad skyed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rga shi tshad myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed ①pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu nang stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu phyi stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu phyi nang stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu ②stong pa nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu chen po 21—805

stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu don dam pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'dus byas stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu thog ma dang tha ma skyed pa stong pa nyid tshad 13phyed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu phyarang bzhin stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu chos thams cad stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu dran pa nye bar gzhag pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad 21—806

myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu yang dag par spong ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu dbang po tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu stobs tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub kyi yan lag tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'phags pa'i bden pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu bsam gtan tshad myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu tshad myed pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam par thar pa brgyad tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu mngon par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu ting nge 'dzin tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad 21—807

myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu phyagazungs kyi sgo tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu myi 'jigs pa bzhi tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi tshad myed pa'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /②sha ra dwa ti'i bu snying rje chen po tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa snubargyad tshad myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu thams cad shes pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do// //shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po nyi shu drug ④pa / gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gal te gzugs zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshor ba zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do//gal te 'du shes zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la 21—808

spyod do/ /gal te 'du byed zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par shes pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myig zab ces bya bar myi spyod na / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rna ba zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sna zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lce zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lus zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te yid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do//gal te gzugs zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sgra zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dri zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ro zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te reg zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te chos zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myig gi rnam par shes pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rna ba'i rnam par shes pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sna'i rnam par shes pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lce'i rnam par shes pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 21—809

lus kyi rnam par shes pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te yid kyi rnam par shes pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myig gi 'dus te reg pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sna'i 'dus te reg pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lce'i 'dus te reg pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lus kyi 'dus te reg pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te yid kyi 'dus te reg pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sa'i khams zab ②ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin 21—810

pa la spyod do/ /gal te chu'i khams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mye'i khams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rlung gi khams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te nam mkha'i khams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par shes pa'i khams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ma rig pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'du byed zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par shes pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mying dang gzugs zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te skye mched drug zab ces bya bar myi spyod na / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te reg pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshor ba zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sred pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do//gal te len pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te srid pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te skye ba zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rga shi zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa

zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi ①pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ga shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te nang stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te phyi stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te phyi nang stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te stong pa nyid stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te chen po stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te don dam pa stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'dus byas stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes 21—812

rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ①pa la spyod do/ /gal te dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rang bzhin stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te chos thams cad stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myi dmigs pa stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dran pa nye bar gzhag pa durnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa la spyod do/ /gal te yang dag par spong ba rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dbang po rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te stobs rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te byang chub kyi yan lag rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi 21—813

pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te bsam gtan rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshad skyed pa rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do//gal te rnam par thar pa brgyad zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang /smon pa myed pa zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mngon par shes pa rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ting nge 'dzin rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te gzungs kyi sgo rnams zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myi 'jigs pa bzhi zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te snying rje chen po zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sangs rgyas kyi 21—814

chos ma 'dres pa ba'o ①brgyad zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te thams cad shes pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid zab ces bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzugs kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ gzugs ma yin no/ /tshor ba'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ tshor ba ma yin no/ /'du shes kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ 'du shes ma yin no/ /'du byed kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ 'du byed ma yin no/ /rnam par shes pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /myig gi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/myig ma yin no/ /rna ba'i zab pa nyid gang yin byepa de ni/ rna ba ma yin no/ /sna'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ sna ma yin no/ /lce'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ lce ma yin no/ /lus kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ lus ma yin no/ /yid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ yid ma yin no/ /gzugs kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ gzugs ma yin no/ /sgra'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ sgra ma yin no/ /dri'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/dri ma yin no/ /ro'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni②/ ro ma yin no/ /reg gi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ reg ④ma yin no/ /chos kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ chos ma yin no/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ myig gi rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /rna ba'i rnam par 21—815

shes pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ sna'i rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ lce'i rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i zab pa ①nyid gang yin pa de ni/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/②rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no//lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/21—816

lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /sa'i khams kyi zab ①pa nyid gang yin pa de ni / sa'i khams ma yin no/ /chu'i khams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/chu'i khams ma yin no/ /mye'i khams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ mye'i khams ma yin no/ /rlung gi khams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rlung gi khams ma yin no/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/nam mkha'i khams ma yin no/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par shes pa'i khams ma yin no/ /ma rig pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ ma rig pa ma yin no/ /'du byed kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ 'du byed ma yin no/ /rnam par shes pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /mying dang gzugs kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ mying dang gzugs ma yin no/ /skye mched drug gi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ skye mched drug ma yin no/ /reg pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ reg pa ma yin no/ /tshor ba'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ tshor ba ma yin no/ /srid pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ srid pa ma yin no/ /len pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ len pa ma yin no/ /srid pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ srid pa ma yin no/ /skye ba'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ skye ba ma yin no/ /rga shi'i ②zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rga shi ma yin no/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu 21—817

phyin pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /nang stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ nang stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /①phyi stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ phyi stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ phyi nang stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /chen po stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni / chen po stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ don dam pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid ma yin no / /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /rang bzhin 21—818

stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid ma yin nol/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ma yin no/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ yang dag par spong ba rnams ma yin no/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ma yin no/ /dbang po rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ dbang po rnams ma yin no/ /stobs rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ stobs rnams ma yin no/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ma yin no//'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ma yin no/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ma yin rnal/ /bsam gtan rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ bsam gtan 21—819

rnams ma yin no/ /tshad myed pa rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/tshad myed pa rnams ma yin no/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ma yin no/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/rnam par thar pa brgyad ma yin no/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ma yin no/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ma yin no/ /mngon par shes pa rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/mngon par shes pa rnams ma yin no/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ ting nge 'dzin rnams ma yin no/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams ma yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ①ma yin no/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni / myi 'jigs pa bzhi khyam yin no/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi cham yin no/ /snying rje chen po'i zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ snying rje chen po ma yin no/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa ④brgyad kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad ⑤ma yin no/ /thams cad shes pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ thams cad shes pa nyid ma yin no/ /21—820

lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ma yin no/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gal te gzugs gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshor ba gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'du shes gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'du byed gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par shes pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do//gal te myig gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rna ba gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sna gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lce gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lus gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te yid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te gzugs gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sgra gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab 21—821

kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dri gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ro gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te reg gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te chos gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myig gi rnam par shes pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rna ba'i rnam par shes pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sna'i rnam par shes pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lce'i rnam par shes pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lus kyi rnam par shes pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te yid kyi rnam par shes pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myig gi 'dus te reg pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sna'i 'dus te reg pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lce'i 'dus te reg pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /21—822

gal te lus kyi 'dus te reg pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te yid kyi 'dus te reg pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do//gal te yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sa'i khams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te chu'i khams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mye'i khams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rlung gi khams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te nam mkha'i khams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 21—823

rnam par shes pa'i khams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ma rig pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ①spyod do/ /gal te 'du byed gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par shes pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mying dang gzugs gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te skye mched drug gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te reg pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do//gal te tshor ba gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sred pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te len pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do//gal te srid pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te skye ba gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rga shi gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la 21—824

spyod do/ /gal te bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gting ①dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa la spyod do/ /gal te brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do②/ /gal te shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te nang stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te phyi stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te phyi nang stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te stong pa nyid stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te chen po stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te don dam pa stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'dus byas stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab ①kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do//gal te mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te thog ma dang tha ma 21—825

myed pa stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rang bzhin stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar mi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te chos thams cad stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid gting dpag ①dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te yang dag par spong ba rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dbang po rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te stobs rnams 21—826

gting cadapag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te byang chub kyi yan lag rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do//gal te bsam gtan rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshad myed pa rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par thar pa brgyad gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mngon par shes pa rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do//gal te ting nge 'dzin rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te gzungs kyi sgo rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do//21—827

gal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myi 'jigs pa bzhi gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te snying rje chen po gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa la spyod do/ /gal te thams cad shes pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzugs kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ gzugs ma yin no/ /tshor ba'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ tshor ba ma yin no/ /'du shes kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ 'du shes ma yin no/ /'du byed kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ 'du byed ma yin no/ /rnam par shes pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /myig gi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/myig ma yin no/ /①rna ba'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rna ba ma yin no/ /sna'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ sna ma yin no/ /21—828

lce'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ lce ma yin no/ /lus kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ lus ma yin no/ /yid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ yid ma yin no/ /gzugs kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ gzugs ma yin no/ /sgra'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ sgra ma yin no/ /dri'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ dri ma yin no/ /ro'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ ro ma yin no/ /reg gi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/reg ma yin no/ /chos kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ chos ma yin no/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/myig gi rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ sna'i rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/lce'i rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin 21—829

pa de ni/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /sa'i khams kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ sa'i khams ma yin no/ /chu'i khams kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ chu'i khams ma yin no/ /mye'i khams kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ mye'i khams ma yin no/ /rlung gi khams kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rlung gi khams ma yin no/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ nam mkha'i khams ma yin no/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang 21—830

yin pa de ni/ rnam par shes pa'i khams ma yin no/ /ma rig pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ ma rig pa ma yin no/ /'du byed kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ 'du byed ma yin no/ ci/rnam par shes pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par shes pa ma yin no//mying dang gzugs kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ mying dang gzugs ma yin no/ /skye mched drug gi gting dpag dka' ba gang 1)yin pa de ni / skye mched drug ma yin no/ /reg pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ reg pa ma yin no/ /tshor ba'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ tshor ba ma yin no/ /srid pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni / srid pa ma yin no/ /len pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/len pa ma yin no/ /srid pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/srid pa ma yin no/ /skye ba'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ skye ba ma yin no/ /rga shi'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rga shi ma yin nol/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ②gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /shes 21—831

rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /nang stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ nang stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /phyi stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ phyi stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ phyi nang stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /chen po stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ chen po stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ don dam pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ma yin no//mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni / chos thams cad stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa 21—832

nyid ma yin no/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ma yin no/ /yang dag par spong ba'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ yang dag par spong ba ma yin no/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ma yin no/ /dbang po'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ dbang po ma yin no/ /stobs kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ stobs ma yin no/ /byang chub kyi yan lag gi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/byang chub kyi yan lag ma yin no/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ma yin no/ /'phags pa'i bden pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni / 'phags pa'i bden pa ma yin no/ /bsam gtan gyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ bsam gtan ma yin no/ /tshad myed pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ tshad myed pa ma yin no/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa ma yin no/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi 21—833

gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par thar pa brgyad ①ma yin no//mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ma yin no/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ma yin no/ /mngon par shes pa'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ mngon par shes pa ma yin no/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ ting nge 'dzin ma yin no/ /gzungs kyi sgo'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/gzungs kyi sgo ma yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ma yin no/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi ldum yin no/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa ②ma yin no/ /snying rje chen po'i gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ snying rje chen po ma yin no/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa ④brgyad kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ⑤ma yin no/ /thams cad shes pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ thams cad shes pa nyid ma yin no/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ma yin no/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi gting dpag dka' ba gang yin pa de ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa 21—834

nyid ma yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gal te gzugs tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshor ba tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'du shes tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'du byed tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par shes pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa la spyod dol/ /gal te myig tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rna ba tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sna tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lce tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lus tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te yid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te gzugs tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa la spyod do/ /gal te sgra tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dri tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ro tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do / /gal te reg tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol 21—835

tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te chos tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myig gi rnam par shes pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rna ba'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sna'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ①spyod do/ /gal te lce'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lus kyi rnam par shes pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te yid kyi rnam par shes pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myig gi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sna'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lce'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lus kyi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa la spyod do/ /gal te yid kyi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor 21—836

ba tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do//gal te sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sa'i khams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te chu'i khams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mye'i khams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rlung gi khams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te nam mkha'i khams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par shes pa'i khams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ma rig pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'du byed tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par shes pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mying dang gzugs tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal 21—837

te skye mched drug tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te reg pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshor ba tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sred pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te len pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te srid pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te skye ba tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rga shi tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na①/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do / /gal te nang stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te phyi stong pa nyid tshad myed do 21—838

zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te phyi nang stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te stong pa nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te chen po stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do / /gal te don dam pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'dus byas stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rang bzhin stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te chos thams cad stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes 21—839

rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te yang dag par spong ba rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te dbang po rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te stobs rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te byang chub kyi yan lag rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te bsam gtan rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshad myed pa rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par thar pa brgyad tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha 21—840

rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do / /gal te rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te mngon par shes pa rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ting nge 'dzin rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te gzungs kyi sgo rnams tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te myi 'jigs pa bzhi tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te snying rje chen po tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o ①brgyad tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te thams cad shes pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid tshad myed do zhes bya bar myi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do// //21—841
